title: User-Movie Rating Pair Consistency
scenario: Find pairs of users (user1_name, user2_name) who have rated the exact same set of movies with the exact same ratings. Output unique pairs where user1_id < user2_id.
tableSchema: Users (user_id INT, name VARCHAR), MovieRating (user_id INT, movie_id INT, rating INT)
hint: Aggregate the movies and ratings into an array per user using ARRAY_AGG(), sort the arrays, and perform an INNER JOIN on these arrays.
correctQuery: WITH UserRatings AS (SELECT user_id, ARRAY_AGG(movie_id || ':' || rating ORDER BY movie_id) as profile FROM MovieRating GROUP BY user_id) SELECT u1.name AS user1_name, u2.name AS user2_name FROM UserRatings ur1 JOIN UserRatings ur2 ON ur1.profile = ur2.profile AND ur1.user_id < ur2.user_id JOIN Users u1 ON ur1.user_id = u1.user_id JOIN Users u2 ON ur2.user_id = u2.user_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE Users (user_id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE MovieRating (user_id INT, movie_id INT, rating INT);
